Independence Day - Resurgence
2016-06-18T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/showbiz/coming-soon/independence-day-resurgence-1241296

We always knew they were coming back. After INDEPENDENCE DAY redefined the event movie genre, the next epic chapter brings global devastation on a mind-boggling scale. By means of recovered alien technology, the nations of Earth have joined forces on a colossal defence program to safeguard the planet. But nothing can prepare us for the aliens' cutting-edge and unmatched force. Only the ingenuity of a few courageous men and women can bring our world back from the edge of annihilation.

Starring Liam Hemsworth, Jeff Goldblum, Bill Pullman, Judd Hirsch, Maika Monroe and more, the film is due for release on the 24th of June. Watch out before it is too late.
